identity.name: Tubby Cats
identity.notes: 20,000-item CC0 collection. A public community conversion repository contains VRM files for a small named/token-numbered subset; this is preserved as partial inventory and is not treated as proof that all Tubby Cats were converted.

evidence.note: Current token profile exposes the project Discord and official site.
Whitelist mint opened Feb. 21, 2022; public mint followed Feb. 23. The catalog records the first collection mint date.

storage.note: Recovered community VRM conversions are stored as public GitHub repository blobs/raw HTTPS files. This does not claim that the original NFT metadata or the full 20,000-token collection stores VRMs on GitHub.

evidence.note: Untruncated repository tree exposes token-numbered .vrm files together with source Blender and GLB assets.

vrm_inventory.note: These eight token-numbered public VRMs are exhaustively enumerated from the current untruncated la53rshark/tubby-cats repository tree. The repository also contains a non-token-named Ratwell derivative, which is deliberately excluded from collection-token inventory. Eight public conversions do not establish exhaustive coverage of the 20,000-token collection, so the state remains partial until a broader authoritative inventory is proven.

evidence.note: Repository tree is not truncated and contains .vrm files in token-numbered directories 159, 1044, 5357, 7696, 8624, 9105, 18362 and 18595.
July 2022 avatar-interoperability notes identify the Tubby community repositories and describe Tubby assets as GLB and VRM.

file_access.note: The recovered community VRM subset is directly downloadable from a public GitHub repository without token ownership or account credentials. This access conclusion applies to the enumerated subset only.

ip_rights.summary: Tubby Cats artwork is released under CC0/public-domain terms, and the recovered community VRM repository itself carries a CC0 1.0 Universal license. Reuse of this public conversion subset is therefore not conditioned on token ownership.

evidence.note: Current Etherscan collection description identifies Tubby Cats as CC0.
Current collection description independently identifies the artwork as CC0.
The community VRM repository includes the full CC0 1.0 Universal legal code.

project_status.note: The official Tubby Cats site and named project social/community surfaces remain live in 2026. No project sunset announcement was found in the current official surfaces checked.
